description: IRS per diem rates for any US location under the high-low method (Revenue Procedure 2019-48): classifies the location as high-cost or low-cost and returns the lodging and meals-and-incidentals (M&IE) amounts. For travel expense reimbursement, accountable plans, and expense management. Cost: $0.25 USDC via x402.
